aiBrief.title: AI brief for on-brand HTML
aiBrief.prompt:
Generate HTML for a content block on a BigBike product detail page. Hard requirements:
- Return plain HTML with inline CSS only (the style="..." attribute). NO <script>, NO <style> tag, no classes, no ids.
- Fonts: body text uses "Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif"; headings use "'Barlow Condensed', Arial, sans-serif", UPPERCASE and bold.
- Font sizes: body 18px; notes/captions 14px.
- Colors: main text #111111; secondary text #6f6f6f; accent (headings, key numbers) #cc0906; links #005fcc.
- Tables and frames: 1px solid #dddddd border; white #ffffff background; square corners (border-radius: 0); table header cells use #f5f5f5 background and bold text.
- Spacing in multiples of 4px (4, 8, 12, 16, 24px).
- NO dark backgrounds, box-shadow, gradients, or any color outside the list above.

Content to present (replace with your own):
[paste your content here]

You may style it with inline CSS — match the product page's fonts, colors and spacing, and avoid odd backgrounds/shadows/colors that clash. Only unsafe code is filtered; the preview below is exactly what customers see. Switching back to "Structured input" clears the HTML so the row table takes effect.
